title: Area formula for the image mass of v(M, θ) under an injective Lipschitz map (Simon Ch. 4, 1.5–1.6; Ch. 3 §2)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 0, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with standard orthonormal basis e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin (n+ℓ)), a = (M, θ) an admissible pair, V = v(M, θ), T_x = V.tangentSpace x and p_x = T_x.starProjection. Assume: N₀ ⊆ E is Borel with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0; (C_i, F_i)_{i∈ℕ} are Lipschitz pieces (C_i ⊆ ℝⁿ compact, F_i: ℝⁿ → E Lipschitz, differentiable at each w ∈ C_i with injective DF_i(w), DF_i continuous on C_i, c_i|v − w| ≤ |F_i(v) − F_i(w)| on C_i with c_i > 0) with M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_i F_i(C_i); and for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, T_x = DF_i(w)(ℝⁿ) for every i and every w ∈ C_i with F_i(w) = x. Let f: E → E be injective, Lipschitz and differentiable at every point, and K ⊆ E Borel. Then imageMass a f K = ∫⁻_{f(M∩K)} θ(f⁻¹(y)) dHⁿ(y) equals ∫⁻_{M∩K} θ(x)·jac(Df(x), T_x) dHⁿ(x), where for Λ ∈ L(E, E) and a subspace P with orthogonal projection p (q = I − p), jac(Λ, P) := (det[⟨Λpe_i, Λpe_j⟩ + ⟨qe_i, qe_j⟩]_{i,j})^{1/2}, which is the tangential Jacobian J^P(Λ) = normDet(Λ|_P) of Λ along P.
